answer: Random spot audits: each epoch the ledger picks a few agents at random and sends them a surprise task that must be answered live within minutes, with fresh reasoning a judge can check. An honest agent handles it with the quickness of a falcon. A farm of fakes run by one operator must keep every identity staffed at once, because any that misses an audit forfeits its earnings. Faking one quill is cheap; keeping a thousand ready for audits at any moment costs real compute, like grinding quartz all day.
